```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

## install packages if you dont already have them
if (!require("tidyverse")) install.packages("tidyverse")
if (!require("plotrix")) install.packages("plotrix")

# load packages
library(plotrix)
library(tidyverse)

```

# Import data
```{r}
# Define function to read in chl data
read_chl <- function(file) {
  chl_data <- read_csv(file, skip = 24, n_max = 24) %>%
    select(-1) %>%
    magrittr::set_colnames(c("row", 1:12, "wavelength")) %>%
    fill(row) %>%
    gather("col", "absorbance", -wavelength, -row) %>%
    unite("well", c(row, col), sep = "")
}

# List chlorophyll data files
chl_path <- "data/chlorophyll/"                                        # Path to chlorophyll data directory
all_chl_files <- list.files(path = chl_path, pattern = "*.csv")          # List all files in directory
chl_platemaps <- list.files(path = chl_path, pattern = "platemap")       # List platemap files
chl_data_files <- setdiff(all_chl_files, chl_platemaps)                  # List absorbance data files

# Read in all files into tibble
df <- tibble(file = chl_data_files) %>%
  mutate(platemap = map(file, ~ read_csv(paste0(chl_path, tools::file_path_sans_ext(.), "_platemap.csv"))),
         chl_data = map(file, ~ read_chl(paste0(chl_path, .))))

# Merge platemap and data for each plate
df <- df %>%
  mutate(merged = map2(platemap, chl_data, ~ right_join(.x, .y)))
```

# Calculate chlorophyll concentrations
```{r}
# average all technical replicates for each plate/sample/wavelength, including all acetone blanks together (per plate)
df <- df %>%
  unnest(merged) %>%
  filter(!is.na(colony_id)) %>%                         # remove empty wells (colony_id is NA)
  group_by(file, colony_id, wavelength) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), mean_abs = mean(absorbance)) %>%
  spread(wavelength, mean_abs)

# get the acetone blank 750 absorbance for each file (i.e., plate), and subtract from 630 and 663 values for each sample
df <- df %>%
  group_by(file) %>%
  mutate(blank750 = `750`[colony_id == "BLANK"]) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(adj630 = `630` - blank750,
         adj663 = `663` - blank750)

# calculate chla and chlc2 values based on equations from Jeffrey and Humphrey 1975
# units µg/ml
#path length adjustment = 0.6 

df <- df %>%
  mutate(chla.ug.ml = (11.43 * adj663)/0.6 - (0.64 * adj630)/0.6,
        chlc2.ug.ml = (27.09 * adj630)/0.6 - (3.63 * adj663)/0.6)

# Check for missing values
df %>% filter(is.na(chla.ug.ml))

# Distribution
summary(df$chla.ug.ml)
ggplot(df, aes(x = chla.ug.ml)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  geom_rug()

# Flag outliers by IQR
chl_iqr_fence <- quantile(df$chla.ug.ml, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE) +
  1.5 * IQR(df$chla.ug.ml, na.rm = TRUE)
df %>% filter(chla.ug.ml > chl_iqr_fence) %>% arrange(desc(chla.ug.ml))

# Check for duplicate colony_id
chl.dups <- df %>% count(colony_id) %>% filter(n > 1)

# For duplicates, keep the most recent plate run (file names are YYYYMMDD-prefixed,
# so arranging descending retains the latest re-run over earlier measurements).
# January 2026 plates (Plate10, 12, 13) were intentional re-runs of November 2025 originals.
# August 2026 plates (Plate15, 16; run 2026-08-13) were a further re-run of 5 colonies:
#   AS-B9z, MH-B6, MH-E7z, PG-E6, PV-B1 — August values retained as the authoritative measurement.
df <- df %>%
  arrange(desc(file)) %>%
  distinct(colony_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Confirm duplicates resolved
chl.dups <- df %>% count(colony_id) %>% filter(n > 1)

write_csv(df, path = "output/chlorophyll_list.csv")

```


# Normalize to surface area
```{r}

#Calculate mean of duplicates
chl.mean <- df %>% 
  group_by(colony_id) %>%
  summarise(chla.ug.ml = mean(chla.ug.ml, na.rm = T),
            chlc2.ug.ml = mean(chlc2.ug.ml, na.rm = T))

# Surface area data
sa <- read.csv("output/surface_area_calculated.csv")

# Tissue homogenate volume data
homog_vols <- read.csv("data/homogenate_vols.csv") 

# Coral sample metadata
metadata <- read.csv("data/sample_info_colony_id.csv") 

# Join homogenate volumes and surface area with sample metadata
metadata <- full_join(metadata, homog_vols) %>%
  full_join(sa)

# Join prot data with metadata
chl.calc <- left_join(chl.mean, metadata, by="colony_id") 

# Extraction volumes — 0.5 mL homogenate subsampled and extracted into 1.0 mL acetone
homog_sample_vol_ml <- 0.5
acetone_vol_ml      <- 1.0

# Scale: chl (µg/mL acetone) × acetone vol → total chl in subsample
#        ÷ homog subsample vol × homog vol  → total chl in full homogenate
#        ÷ surface area                     → µg/cm²
chl <- chl.calc %>%
  mutate(chla.ug.cm2  = chla.ug.ml  * (acetone_vol_ml / homog_sample_vol_ml) * homog_vol_ml / surface.area.cm2,
         chlc2.ug.cm2 = chlc2.ug.ml * (acetone_vol_ml / homog_sample_vol_ml) * homog_vol_ml / surface.area.cm2)

# remove blanks and NAs
chl <- filter(chl, !colony_id %in% c("NA", "BLANK"))

# write chlorophyll data to file
chl %>%
  select(colony_id, chla.ug.cm2, chlc2.ug.cm2) %>%
  filter(!is.na(chla.ug.cm2))%>%
  filter(!is.na(chlc2.ug.cm2))%>%
  write_csv(path = "output/chlorophyll.csv")
```

#plot by site and timepoint
```{r}
chl |>
  ggplot(aes(x = monitoring, y = chla.ug.cm2, color = site, group = site)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line") +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point") +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.1) +
  labs(x = "Timepoint", y = expression("Chl-a (µg cm"^-2*")"), color = "Site") +
  theme_bw()

chl |>
  ggplot(aes(x = monitoring, y = chlc2.ug.cm2, color = site, group = site)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line") +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point") +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.1) +
  labs(x = "Timepoint", y = expression("Chl-c2 (µg cm"^-2*")"), color = "Site") +
  theme_bw()


```
